market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil near $100 and inflation reacceleration, partially offset by Fed rate-cut expectations from soft wage growth. Tech/AI names volatile as smart money rotates to power. Expect elevated VIX and bond yield volatility. Labor Day sales may provide modest consumer data but K-shaped divergence limits upside.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle continues but broadens from chips to power, geothermal, and infrastructure. Energy transition capital (lithium, copper, wind) remains structurally supported. Geopolitical fragmentation (Dutch gold, Iran sanctions) drives persistent safe-haven demand. K-shaped economy persists, favoring essential over discretionary. Fed likely cuts 50-75bps over next two quarters if inflation stabilizes post-oil shock.
